text: Remove unused projecting ledges and use a light patterned sliding end piece on the separate rod-mounted battery holder.
A friction-only battery holder was considered and parked after the battery came out under heavy shaking.
For the separate battery holder, route the leads through the opening without the extra wire clip.
The separate rod-mounted holder was sized for a PKCELL LP402025 pouch. This size applies to that holder only.
Size the standalone tray to the thinner Micron pack and retain it snugly.
